approval_decision_time_check.name: approval_decision_time_check
approval_decision_time_check.value: ("approval"."decision" = 'pending' AND "approval"."decided_at" IS NULL) OR ("approval"."decision" <> 'pending' AND "approval"."decided_at" IS NOT NULL AND "approval"."decided_at" >= "approval"."requested_at")

approval_consumption_check.name: approval_consumption_check
approval_consumption_check.value: "approval"."consumed_at" IS NULL OR ("approval"."decision" = 'approved' AND "approval"."decided_at" IS NOT NULL AND "approval"."consumed_at" >= "approval"."decided_at")

kb_chunk_validity_check.name: kb_chunk_validity_check
kb_chunk_validity_check.value: "kb_chunk"."valid_from" IS NULL OR "kb_chunk"."valid_to" IS NULL OR "kb_chunk"."valid_to" > "kb_chunk"."valid_from"

source_validity_check.name: source_validity_check
source_validity_check.value: "source"."valid_from" IS NULL OR "source"."valid_to" IS NULL OR "source"."valid_to" > "source"."valid_from"
